frozen_command.source_import_contract: The frozen python -c adapter inserts the E529 snapshot scripts directory before runpy executes the root predictor, so import train_rnn resolves to this snapshot; PYTHONPATH then resolves wnn modules from the same snapshot. WNN_PROJECT_ROOT points data, cache, checkpoint and output resolution to the main project root.
